The BinaryWave indicator itself is a composite of 7 weighted sub-indicators with JJMA smoothing - requires manual Python reimplementation of the custom indicator logic.

derived_values.name: BinaryWave
derived_values.formula: weighted_sum = WeightMA*MA_signal + WeightMACD*MACD_signal + WeightOsMA*OsMA_signal + WeightCCI*CCI_signal + WeightMOM*MOM_signal + WeightRSI*RSI_signal + WeightADX*ADX_signal; each sub-signal is binary (+1/-1); result smoothed by bMA_Method(JJMA, period=5, phase=100)

derived_values.name: BinaryWave_breakdown_signal
derived_values.formula: Value[1]>0 AND Value[0]<=0 => BUY; Value[1]<0 AND Value[0]>=0 => SELL (zero crossover)

derived_values.name: BinaryWave_twist_signal
derived_values.formula: Value[1]<Value[2] AND Value[0]>Value[1] => BUY (wave direction change to up); Value[1]>Value[2] AND Value[0]<Value[1] => SELL (wave direction change to down)

custom_logic_notes: Two entry modes: 'breakdown' (zero-line crossover of BinaryWave) and 'twist' (direction change of smoothed BinaryWave). The BinaryWave indicator is a composite of 7 standard indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX) each converted to binary +/-1 signals, weighted, summed, then smoothed by JJMA (JMA) algorithm from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous closed bar (bar index 1). In breakdown mode, Value[0] is bar at SignalBar, Value[1] is bar at SignalBar+1 - detecting crossover of zero line. In twist mode, 3 bars are read to detect direction change. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates controlling which trade actions are permitted.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement BinaryWave indicator: compute 7 sub-indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX), convert each to binary signal (+1 if bullish, -1 if bearish), apply weights, sum, then smooth with JJMA algorithm. JJMA (JMA) is a proprietary smoothing algorithm from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - need to find or reimplement the Jurik/JJMA smoothing. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose - standard market order execution with SL/TP. Two entry modes need separate implementation: breakdown (zero crossover) and twist (direction reversal). Position sizing logic: MM<0 means fixed lot |MM|, MM>0 means fraction of deposit.
